closure_decision: No evidence-state changes. NASA gains an exact sixteen-action non-closure; HHS gains two bounded component control tests with distinct periods and results.
substitution_rule: Open is not implemented or closed; no recommendation is not agency closure; one provider test is not a department or sector result.
comparison_rule: The two anonymous hospital audits use different entities, test periods, frameworks, and scopes and do not support ranking or comparative performance claims.
